clock: Origin coordinator serializes authenticated notice, refusal admission, and closure events.
formula: starts_at = max(finalized_at, notice_at); deadline = starts_at + duration_ms
boundary: A refusal admitted at the deadline wins; closure must be strictly later.
missing_evidence: No missing notice, unavailable status, or unresolved race yields a fabricated deadline or closed-window status.
freshness: Illustrative current-status policy; no wall-clock promise of cross-service instantaneous knowledge.
clock_uncertainty_rule: If uncertainty overlaps an admission deadline or evidence freshness limit, do not assert closure/current permission.
first_notice_rule: Earliest durably verified qualifying notice after finalization; duplicates do not restart windows.
unstarted_refusal: A principal may refuse after finalization before a qualifying notice; missing notice cannot suppress refusal.
selection_authority: Each promiser serializes its own capacity across negotiations; coordinator finalization requires recoverable selection evidence.
